# Third-party code

Baselines and evaluation tools used in the benchmark. They are vendored here, with small compatibility fixes, so that the experiments can be reproduced with a single environment. All credit goes to their original authors; please cite the corresponding papers and respect their licences.

| Folder | Used for | Source |
|--------|----------|--------|
| `TSInterpret/` (v0.4.7) | CoMTE, TSEvo, SETS baselines | [fzi-forschungszentrum-informatik/TSInterpret](https://github.com/fzi-forschungszentrum-informatik/TSInterpret) (BSD-3-Clause) |
| `confetti/` | CONFETTI baseline | CONFETTI, University of Luxembourg (MIT, see `confetti/LICENSE`) |
| `lasts/` | LASTS baseline | [fspinna/lasts](https://github.com/fspinna/lasts) (Spinnato et al.) |
| `tshap/` | TSHAP50 alignment metric | TSHAP (Nguyen & Ifrim) |
